blurb: Located in Staten Island, New York, La Tourette Golf Course is home to the annual New York City Amateur Championship held at the end of May, and The March of Dimes Celebrity Charity Event held every June. From the time you enter the restored manor that serves as the clubhouse, you will sense the rich history and high caliber of service that we value so much.
